subject.label: linux-v6.12-macos
subject.title: the Linux v6.12 source tree
subject.provenance: Reproduced as the linux-v6.12 records (e.g. exp-178) describe: git clone --depth 1 --branch v6.12 https://github.com/torvalds/linux.git, HEAD adc218676eef25575469234709c2d87185ca223a (tag v6.12, tree ac4266ccaf1cf79e8fb22ad3e0d86deac358ffb9), git 2.50.1. Cloned on the external drive (kept there) and copied with ditto to the internal SSD, where it was fingerprinted and timed.
subject.shape_difference: 92,460 entries here against 92,474: 13 fewer files because APFS here is case-insensitive and git keeps one path of each of 13 case-colliding pairs (netfilter headers and sources, one litmus test), and 1 fewer directory, most likely .git/branches, which older git templates create (inference). Bytes differ by the .git pack the server sent and by APFS against ext4 allocation.
subject.storage_detail: internal APFS SSD (Apple M1 Pro Data volume, case-insensitive): the measured tree (in a Spotlight-excluded .noindex directory), the timed fdu and perf_probe binaries (sha256-verified copies), the harness source, its venv and its temporary directory, which holds every cache directory and snapshot, were all on the internal volume during timing; only logs and results were written to the external drive
